title: Console UX: Release operations checklist for dashboards, rollouts, and cost breakdowns
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Coordinate the end-to-end release operations for three console UX features landing in console-2026.03: new Dashboards view, Canary Rollouts UI, and Token-level Cost Breakdown. Scope includes release notes, staging validation checklist, engineer/SE training, outbound messaging, support runbooks, and last-mile fixes identified in beta.
acceptance_criteria: Consolidated release notes (customer-facing + internal) approved by PM + Eng
Support runbook with triage steps and rollback play included and uploaded to Confluence
Two training sessions delivered (Engineers/SEs + Customer Success) and recording uploaded
Console staging smoke tests green on canary cluster for both dashboard widgets and cost breakdown samples
Rollout plan and automated feature flag schedule configured and QAed
launch_tasks: Draft customer-facing release notes and short changelog bullets (for emails and docs)
Prepare internal release memo for Sales, Support, and Partner teams
Coordinate with Eng to freeze migrations: dashboard schema change and cost aggregation job
Create staging test plan and assign owners for smoke tests
Schedule two training workshops and capture slide deck + recording
Publish support runbook and create triage Slack channel
Prepare example API/SDK snippets for release notes and SDK changelog
Confirm feature flag gating and canary schedule with infra
release_notes_lines: Dashboards: customizable widget layout, faster load times for large orgs, CSV export
Rollouts: Canary Rollouts UI - target by route or model and automated fallback policies
Cost Breakdown: Token-level and route-level cost views with filtering and export
Known issue: Two-edge case KV-cache artifact under investigation; fallback enabled by default
training_plan: Engineer deep-dive: 60m + Q&A — topics: dashboard schema, cost aggregation, rollout orchestration
CS enablement: 45m — how to read cost breakdowns, canned troubleshooting flows
Sales deck update: 15 slide highlights and 3 customer use cases
Recording and FAQ posted to Confluence with timestamped clips
go_to_market_assets: Release notes page (Docs) with code snippets
One-pager for Sales: feature bullets + differentiation vs competitors
Blog outline for launch week with example customer stories
comments: 2026-03-02 Priya: Kickoff meeting notes uploaded. Action items: Eng to provide migration window by 2026-03-08.
2026-03-04 Marcus: Eng flagged a potential regression in cost aggregation for large orgs; running perf job to validate. Assigned ENG-4107.
2026-03-08 Anika: Draft of release notes ready for PM review. Need final examples from SDK team.
2026-03-10 Liam: Training times confirmed for 2026-03-18 and 2026-03-19. Recording infra booked.
2026-03-11 Maya: Support runbook initial draft includes troubleshooting flow and escalation matrix — please review.
risks: Performance regression on cost aggregation for orgs > 10k requests/day
Migration window conflicts with existing Dedicated capacity maintenance
Documentation gaps for advanced cost filters leading to support load
mitigations: Add extra perf run and synthetic traffic tickets (ENG-4124) and hold rollout for orgs >10k until green
Coordinate maintenance calendar with infra and prefer a rolling migration window
Prepare quick-start examples and a short how-to video to reduce support questions
